Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent raster architectural background vignette for a short premium real estate website card. This is artwork only, NOT a full UI design.
Primary request: a sophisticated, highly detailed monochrome editorial architectural engraved / technical-pencil illustration of the corner elevation of a contemporary residential building. Finished professional architectural draftsmanship, extremely refined graphite and silver fine linework, precise perspective, distinct repeated vertical window rhythm, realistic window framing depth, a setback terrace, elegantly recessed street entrance, and a restrained courtyard hint.
Subject: a plausible five-storey contemporary European-style apartment building seen from its front-right corner with expertly drawn masonry seams, slender window mullions, balcony railings and subtle controlled fine hatch shading. A small hint of a raised planter and courtyard paving near the entrance. A few surrounding architectural plan construction lines continue under and behind the building, without dimensions or labels. The building and plan lines form a single restrained polished architectural vignette. No extra isolated icons or props.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal landscape approximately 2:1 composition if possible. Building subject occupies the RIGHT TWO THIRDS of the canvas, with largely empty transparent negative space on the LEFT. Entire building visible and not clipped, clean transparent outer margins. Intended to be placed on the RIGHT of a short card roughly 200 pixels tall, displayed around 460 by 260 pixels, behind solid-filled cyan and white UI buttons added later by the website. Do not draw any buttons or user interface. Finely detailed but composed to read well at small size.
Style/medium: professional architectural etched engraving and precise technical graphite draftsmanship, premium editorial quality. Thin mid-graphite and soft-silver strokes only, delicate dimensional hatching, restrained tonal range, no thick black filled areas. Neither a loose sketch nor a simplistic line icon; no cartoon, toy house, SVG-like primitive geometry or scribbles. A finished technically accomplished architectural illustration.
Color palette: monochrome mid graphite and soft silver linework only, suitable for later display at 12–20% CSS opacity on either a milk-white or dark graphite card.
Scene/backdrop: TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background everywhere outside individual drawn lines and light restrained hatch marks. NO white canvas, NO paper texture, NO washed rectangular backdrop, NO opaque fill beneath the whole drawing, NO studio backdrop. The building's wall planes should mostly remain transparent with fine linework and tiny controlled hatching defining their form. Very clean transparent edges.
Constraints: no people, no human figures, no text, no letters, no words, no numerals, no measurements, no dimension values, no labels, no logos, no watermarks. No high-contrast black blobs. No book, notebook, pen or key. No full UI.
